Class PhotonVisionWrapper

java.lang.Object
yall.VisionCamera
yall.cameras.PhotonVisionWrapper
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public class PhotonVisionWrapper extends VisionCamera
A PhotonVision camera.

In simulation, PhotonVision's camera simulation publishes to this PhotonCamera, so code that uses getCamera() directly sees simulated results too. Let this wrapper read the results: PhotonCamera.getAllUnreadResults() hands each result out only once.

Pose estimates come from PhotonPoseEstimator: the coprocessor's multi-tag result, falling back to the lowest-ambiguity single tag. With PoseEstimationMode.HEADING_ASSISTED it tries the PnP distance trig solve first.

Without a camera model in the config, it is simulated as a CameraModel.ARDUCAM_OV9281.

No vendor configs are accepted; use getCamera() for PhotonVision settings.
